title: fix(pin): the missing-entry remedy builds with declarations whatever OS_SKIP_DTS is exported
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQsA4oacuXitsZSz3thMBc7)_

Fixes #13017

The branch was named by the PM seat (`claude/issue-13017-pin-remedy-skip-dts`).

## What changed

When `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` names a tree whose `@objectstack/*` packages were built without declarations, `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` refuses it ("... is not built in TREE: its manifest points at `dist/index.d.ts`, which is not there") and prints a command that builds the tree. That command ran under the caller's shell, so with `OS_SKIP_DTS` exported it rebuilt the tree typeless and the same refusal repeated.

- The printed remedy now reads `(cd TREE && env -u OS_SKIP_DTS pnpm --filter-prod NAME... run build)`. The unset is part of the command, so it holds whatever the shell exported.
- When the shell did export `OS_SKIP_DTS`, one more line names the variable and says the command builds without it.
- The refusal itself, its conditions and exit are unchanged. No new gate.
- One new test in `scripts/__tests__/objectstack-pin.test.ts` pins the remedy command with `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset and set; the existing refusal test is untouched and still passes.

Files: `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` (+3 -1), `scripts/__tests__/objectstack-pin.test.ts` (+26).

## Gates (hand-derived from `.github/workflows/lint.yml` and `package.json`; objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`)

Head `f20f73c`. Exit codes captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/objectstack-pin.test.ts` (from the worktree root, under the shared verify lock) :: exit 0, 1 file, 38 tests passed.
- Ablation (fix committed first, then `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` replaced by its parent's bytes, `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS` count 0 on disk): same command :: exit 1, 1 failed / 37 passed, the failure is the new test. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs`; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs scripts/__tests__/objectstack-pin.test.ts` :: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-test-path-roots.mjs` :: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-vi-mock-override-shape.mjs` :: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` :: exit 0 (0 new citations)
- `node scripts/check-lint-coverage.mjs` :: exit 0
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` :: exit 0 (no changeset owed: the diff touches no published source)
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs scripts/__tests__/objectstack-pin.test.ts` :: exit 0, NOT GOVERNED (ordinary PR)
- Everything else CI runs is left to the PR's check-runs.

## Acceptance notes

- Premise re-read at `main` `1aa88519`: the `--filter-prod NAME...` list is built in `build()` and the remedy named no `OS_SKIP_DTS`. It holds, and the remedy is printed only on the `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT` path.
- Route taken: always prefix `env -u OS_SKIP_DTS` (the PM-suggested route). `OS_SKIP_DTS` is read as "any non-empty value skips declarations" by the build scripts in objectstack, so an unconditional unset is correct for every state, including unset.
- The test asserts the command shape and the variable name, with `OS_SKIP_DTS` unset and set. It does not pin the explanatory sentence word for word.
- NOT MEASURED, not touched: the pin path (no `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT`) passes the caller's environment on to its own nested `pnpm install` and `pnpm run build` in the fetched tree, so an exported `OS_SKIP_DTS` may reach it too. It prints no remedy, so it is outside this card; measuring it needs a network checkout of the pin.
